title: Security
description: Manage two-factor authentication (2FA) for your account.

2fa.title: Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)
2fa.subtitle: Strengthen security with a TOTP code on every sign-in.
2fa.stepHint: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy...) then enter the 6-digit code to activate.
2fa.enabledHint: Your account is protected by two-factor authentication.
2fa.disableHint: Enter your current verification code to disable 2FA.
2fa.setupError: Could not generate the QR code. Please try again.

password.title: Change password
password.subtitle: Update your sign-in password.
password.setPasswordDescription: Your account signs in with Google. Set a password so you can sign in directly.
password.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
password.passwordNeedDigit: Password must contain at least 1 number.
password.changeFailed: Failed to change password. Check your current password.
password.useOtp: Forgot your current password? Change it with an OTP
password.otpHint: Send a confirmation code to your email, then enter the 6-digit code with your new password.
password.otpSent: A confirmation code was sent to your email
password.otpChangeFailed: Failed to change password. The code is wrong or expired.

danger.title: Danger Zone
danger.deactivateHint: Deactivating will lock your account. Data is not permanently deleted.
danger.confirmBody: You will not be able to sign in until reactivated. This can be undone by signing back in.
danger.otpSent: A confirmation code was sent to your email
